diagnosis: Extrahepatic bile duct small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC)
legend: The tumour shows typical small cell morphology with areas of necrosis. Focally an adenocarcinoma component is seen but forms less than 30% of tumour.

diagnosis: Neuroendocrine tumour of the bile duct
legend: Nests and tubules of tumour cells causing transmural invasion of the bile duct wall.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) within intraductal papillary neoplasm of the bile duct (IPNB).
legend: Histologic sections show that the tumor consists of intraductal papillary component along with NEC component.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) within intraductal papillary neoplasm of the bile duct (IPNB).
legend: Strong Chromogranin A expression highlighting the small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma component.

diagnosis: Neuroendocrine tumour (NET) of the common bile duct
legend: A Nests and tubules of tumour cells causing transmural invasion of the bile duct wall.

diagnosis: Mixed adenocarcinoma and small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC) of the perihilar bile duct
legend: A Histologically distinct recognizable components of gland-forming adenocarcinoma and SCNEC are seen. B The neuroendocrine carcinoma (NEC) component is immunohistochemically distinguishable and shows positivity for synaptophysin. C The NEC component is positive for TTF1 labelling. D Both components show a diffuse loss of RB1.

diagnosis: Neuroendocrine tumour (NET) of the common bile duct
Neuroendocrine tumour (NET) of the common bile duct
legend: B Tumour cells show eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm, with round to ovoid nuclei and minimal pleomorphism, and can be seen infiltrating the non-neoplastic biliary glands. The intervening stroma appears sclerotic.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC) of the common bile duct
legend: B The bile duct biopsy shows fragments of high-grade dysplasia (upper left) and SCNEC composed of sheets and nests of cells in a subepithelial growth pattern with a very high N:C ratio, round or ovoid hyperchromatic nuclei with nuclear moulding, homogenously disposed chromatin, and indistinct cell borders.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC) of the common bile duct
legend: C Immunohistochemical staining shows high labelling of Ki-67.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC) of the common bile duct
legend: D Immunohistochemical staining shows diffuse loss of RB1.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC) of the common bile duct
legend: A Cholangiography shows a biliary stricture (arrow) in the lower bile duct.

diagnosis: Small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (SCNEC) within intraductal papillary neoplasm of the bile duct (IPNB)
